lessons.observation: A consistent partial batch still requires manual dependency analysis before the owner knows which evidence to collect next.
lessons.what_worked_or_failed: Batch integrity and replay/conflict controls worked; readiness sequencing was not represented.
lessons.root_cause_or_enabling_factor: The workspace modeled proposed promotions but not the full eight-component dependency graph.
lessons.product_change_made: Added deterministic coverage, dependency blockers, prioritized gaps, and one exact owner action.
lessons.builder_prompt_system_change_made: Added focused tests for valid, missing, invalid, and deterministic plan states.
lessons.future_candidate_selection_effect: Prefer owner tools that turn exact evidence into a bounded next action without creating hidden authority.
lessons.future_testing_or_recovery_effect: Recovery must preserve component order, dependencies, and no-mutation rules.

lessons.observation: A monolithic shell chain can outlive an external tool window even though individual tests pass.
lessons.what_worked_or_failed: The suite was exact and deterministic; command-level attribution was external and manual.
lessons.root_cause_or_enabling_factor: No canonical manifest or stable segmented runner existed.
lessons.test_or_evidence_that_revealed_it: Repeated acceptance execution-window limits during V14 releases.
lessons.builder_prompt_system_change_made: Added the canonical 143-command manifest and stable segmented runner.
lessons.future_candidate_selection_effect: Prefer exact automation that distinguishes runner limits from product failures.
lessons.future_testing_or_recovery_effect: Next builds can re-run exact segments and compare one stable combined log.

unresolved_learning_questions: Which exact GitHub repository and Render service are canonical?
Which external nonsecret receipt should be collected first after those identities are known?
next_version_learning_priorities: Audited evidence application authorization after exact live receipts
